title: Clocked comparator with declared decision latency and hysteresis
description: On the rising clock crossing of vth_clk (ambiguity band clk_band), samples the sign of V(inp,vss)-V(inn,vss) with positive-feedback hysteresis vhyst, and drives out toward vhi or vlo so the 50% output crossing occurs td after the clock threshold crossing. Output is defined against the vss reference port behind a thevenin rout.

output_drive.edge_convention: t_rise/t_fall between vlo and vhi levels; td is measured clock-threshold to out 50% crossing

parameters.name: td
parameters.description: Clock-threshold-crossing to output-50%-crossing latency. Must exceed tedge/2 + 7 ps: 7 ps is the largest fixed event-chain overhead across the executable backends (native needs 2 ps, xspice-cosim 7 ps), so every admitted parameterization yields the declared td on both.

parameters.name: tedge
parameters.description: Output rise/fall time between vlo and vhi.

parameters.name: vhyst
parameters.description: Full hysteresis width applied as +/-vhyst/2 threshold shift from the retained decision. Exactly zero disables hysteresis.

parameters.name: clk_band
parameters.description: Declared clock ambiguity band; event ordering inside it is unspecified.

parameters.name: dif_band
parameters.description: Declared decision ambiguity band around zero differential input.

state.name: decision
state.value_before_first_event: 0 (out at vlo) until the first rising clock event

unsupported.behavior: No meaningful small-signal path exists through the event decision; AC results describe only the passive output stage.
Noise contributions are absent, not zero-modeled; report noise as unavailable.
OP resolves the pre-first-event deterministic default, not a decision.
DC sweeps do not clock the decision element; the retained decision stays at its default.

regularization.name: bridge event delays
regularization.scaling_rule: fixed, subtracted inside the td latency arithmetic
regularization.tested_error_bound: decision-time error < 2 ps against the declared td

limitations: No metastability model: inputs inside dif_band at the clock event resolve deterministically to the LOW decision (out at vlo, hysteresis state low).
No kickback, no input offset parameter, no supply-current model.
Event ordering inside clk_band is unspecified.

timing.ambiguity_window: clk_band around vth_clk; dif_band around zero differential; both declared parameters.
timing.latency_definition: td = time from clock crossing vth_clk (rising) to out crossing (vhi+vlo)/2, exact to within the regularization bound.

verilog-a.notes: Continuous OSDI-compilable backend (no event constructs: the OSDI path refuses @(cross)/transition because ngspice does not honor their sampled semantics). The event contract is realized by continuous stages whose softness sits inside the contract's declared ambiguity bands: the clock gate's aperture spans ~clk_band around vth_clk; the decision boundary sits at +dif_band/2 with a tanh width of dif_band/8, so the dif_band interior resolves LOW deterministically. td and tedge are decoupled by a constant-rate ramp delay generator (soft-clamped integrator) feeding a threshold stage. Measured regularization (tests/test_blocks_osdi_comparator.py): |out-50% latency - td| <= 1% of td + 10 ps over the admitted space (worst measured 0.44%); 10-90 edge = 0.8*tedge within 15% (the native ramp's 10-90); decision-time timestep invariance < 100 ps over a 50x tstep range. Backend-specific limitations: the clk-high (and clk-low) phase must exceed ~td for declared-latency acquisition -- phases under ~0.09*td never decide (deterministic low), phases between decide late; the retained decision leaks with tau ~ 125 us * (td/2ns), so hysteresis weakens for clock periods approaching that scale; a clock already high at t=0 holds the deterministic default low until a real rising edge, matching the event backends.

parameter_constraints.rationale: The delay stage realizing td is d_buffer(td - tedge/2 - 7p); at or below this bound ngspice would clamp a negative delay and silently return a latency other than the declared td.

xspice-cosim.notes: The compiled 2-state core holds its last value on a digital UNKNOWN, so the decision bridge is crisp at +dif_band/2 (same observable boundary as native; in-band inputs decide LOW at the bridge instead of via the dac out_undef mapping). The rising clock event fires at the clk_band in_high crossing, a deterministic choice inside the declared ambiguity band. Latency chain: adc 1p + d_cosim model delay 1p + event-bridge residual 5p + d_buffer (td - tedge/2 - 7p) + dac ramp tedge/2 = td; this backend therefore requires td > tedge/2 + 7 ps.
